description: Dated retail arrears, temporary repayment proposals and observed competing exit. Monetary amounts EUR. Zero prospective interest is an explicit analytical assumption, not a product pricing convention.

RETAIL_RESIDENTIAL_MORTGAGE.financial_convention: monthly mortgage instalment; capital remains after temporary relief

RETAIL_HOME_EQUITY_LINE.financial_convention: interest-only line; undrawn commitment is not past-due principal

RETAIL_UNSECURED_INSTALLMENT.financial_convention: fixed instalment; reduced first payment is recovered in period three

RETAIL_EDUCATION_LOAN.financial_convention: first contractual payment after documented grace, not during grace

RETAIL_AUTO_LOAN.financial_convention: unpaid balloon; prospective extension preserves principal and accrued interest

RETAIL_AUTO_LEASE.financial_convention: finance-lease monetary claim; returned asset residual value is separate

RETAIL_CREDIT_CARD.financial_convention: minimum due is 50, not full statement balance; revolving principal remains

RETAIL_CHARGE_CARD.financial_convention: full statement due; instalment conversion is a proposal only

RETAIL_OVERDRAFT.financial_convention: explicit demand for excess over authorized 1000; authorized balance is not demanded

RETAIL_BNPL.financial_convention: four-payment plan; missed first instalment plus second due, no annualized good label

RETAIL_MICRO_LOAN.financial_convention: weekly collection with seasonal capacity; later catch-up can remain unaffordable

RETAIL_SMALL_BUSINESS_FINANCE.financial_convention: working-capital principal; owner transfer is not additional operating income
